Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set true and another owner already
                occupies that household; the joining owner and the existing
                owner(s) all carry the same value. Absent for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's
                first name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the
                moment this owner was created; the owner itself is not counted.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and
                an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SILVER'
            locality:

                The owner's region, derived from city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail

          format: uri

        title:
          title: Title

          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException

          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp

          format: date-time

          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array

            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title

        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

      required:

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped and the number is converted to E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits,
            which is the stored and returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255

          title: Registration date
          description: >-

            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's

          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Shares household

              minimum: 0
